prompts.interiors: Use case: stylized-concept. Create original overhead game environment artwork from this written brief only. Do not use any external image, existing game map, named artist, franchise architecture, logo or copied composition. Deliver ONE square image containing EXACTLY FOUR equally sized room tiles in a 2 by 2 grid; boundaries at exactly 50 percent both axes, no gutters, no text, no people. CRITICAL CAMERA: a bird's-eye view straight DOWN at roofless rooms, camera 80 degrees above the ground, orthographic projection, north at image top. This is a playable top-down RPG floor plan, NOT a frontal interior illustration. Show the TOPS of furniture and wall caps, floor covers 85 percent of every tile. All four room outer footprints are squares aligned to image edges, near and far edges the SAME width, floor tiles parallel without a vanishing point, no horizon, no tall rear wall, no ceiling, no view through a window. Short cutaway perimeter walls only, about 8 percent of room height, clear 18-percent-wide opening in the BOTTOM CENTER. Keep the center 45 percent of every room as empty traversable floor. Warm painterly fantasy game textures, crisp silhouettes, restrained ornament, readable at 500px per room. TOP LEFT: druid seed archive carved into an irregular but square timber platform; overhead walnut floor, seed drawers and open seed tray at left middle, broad circular living-tree stump with ribbon wishes at right middle, planters and leaf-shaped low stools around edges, quiet olive and honey colors. TOP RIGHT: mage reading room, slate-blue tiled floor with an original asymmetric constellation of tiny brass inlays; LOW bookshelves seen from above along north/west edges; OPEN BOOK on reading desk at left middle; BRASS ORBITAL GLOBE at right middle, overhead purple rugs; shelves and desk remain low and do not create a frontal wall. BOTTOM LEFT: hunter tracking lodge, weathered oak floor, broad MAP TABLE viewed from above centered at upper third, bow-and-quiver rack on LEFT middle, boot bench and rolled bedrolls around edges, sage and amber palette, no killed animal trophies. BOTTOM RIGHT: knight practice yard INSIDE a roofless cutaway keep room, pale stone square floor, a LOW wooden cross-shaped PRACTICE DUMMY on RIGHT middle, folded blue ceremonial banners displayed flat on a wide table at TOP middle, weapon racks along left edge, narrow cobalt runner along floor. No heraldic animals, famous symbols, shields with copied emblems, text, sky, horizon, point-of-view hands or first-person view. All four must visibly read as overhead level maps.
prompts.buildings: Use case: stylized-concept. Original fantasy game BUILDING SPRITE ATLAS, designed from this written brief alone. ONE landscape image, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, eight equal square cells with exact grid boundaries at 25/50/75 percent width and 50 percent height. One isolated complete building per cell, no overlap, 10 percent clear padding. Actual transparent PNG background, alpha zero, no checkerboard, no ground tiles, no landscape, no text. CRITICAL CAMERA: orthographic bird's-eye camera looking almost straight DOWN, 75 degrees above the ground (15 degrees from vertical), north up. Roof and visible upper footprint occupy at least 75 PERCENT of each building image; only a SHORT south-facing wall strip and entrance threshold below roof, NO tall frontal facades, NO skyline or horizon, NO front elevation illustration. Buildings aligned north/south to image edges, NOT diamond isometric footprints, parallel roof edges no vanishing points. Top surfaces of eaves, chimney openings, tower crenellations and platforms strongly visible. Soft hand-painted materials, clean fine outlines, warm readable 2D fantasy game scenery. Do not base designs on any existing game, famous building, franchise, named artist or logo. TOP ROW left to right: (1) Druid Elderbough Hall, original asymmetric cluster of leaf-roofed timber rooms joined around one open tree canopy, broad visible leaf roofs, small entrance on south center. (2) Mage Starfall Library, squat octagonal teal-purple roof around a low central glass skylight, small brass orbital instrument on roof, reading wings forming a compact square footprint, entrance south center. (3) Hunter Wayfarers Lodge, wide mossy split timber roof with a rope-tied ventilation opening and a little map-reader porch, low wooden walls, entrance south center, no animal trophies. (4) Knight Moonwell Keep, compact pale square stone keep, viewed down INTO open parapet corners and over its broad slate roof, blue fabric roof pennants, low south gatehouse, no copied heraldry. BOTTOM ROW: (1) Druid herbal shop with planted turf roof and square glass greenhouse roof panels; (2) Mage alchemy shop with copper-and-indigo roof, three capped ceramic roof vents, little round blue-glass skylight; (3) Hunter supply shop with broad bark-shingle roof and folded olive canvas awning, tiny overhead crates at threshold; (4) Knight smithy with rust-red low roof, clearly open square chimney seen from above, covered anvil veranda at south edge. Eight distinctly original silhouettes. Same overhead projection on EVERY frame. No people, weapons/logos as coats of arms or modern objects. Preserve true transparency.
prompts.residents: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: replacement fantasy RPG NPC sprite atlas for Bond & Bolt. Input image 1 (assets/cities/residents.png) is the EDIT TARGET: preserve the nine civilian identities, clothing colors, held props, and row/column ordering. Input image 2 (assets/characters/hunter-sheet.png) is the CAMERA, facing, body proportion and hand-painted style reference; do not include the hunter or copy the hunter costume. Primary request: redraw the nine civilians in the same upright, readable three-quarter RIGHT-FACING standing perspective as the hunter idle pose (row 4, column 2), with clear faces, full torsos and legs, visible boots at the bottom, the same camera elevation as that reference. They stand on the same ground plane as the class sprites. The user rejected the previous looking-down overhead human view. All nine turn to screen RIGHT (mild three-quarter front-right), neutral friendly idle poses. Square canvas divided into exactly THREE EQUAL COLUMNS and THREE EQUAL ROWS; nine evenly spaced full-body people, one per cell. Keep 10 percent transparent padding all around each person and no overlap across cell boundaries. Row 1: gray-haired elderly herbalist with sage shawl and wicker herb basket; dark-skinned gardener with straw hat, green overalls and watering can; auburn curly-haired bard in ochre with lute. Row 2: elderly librarian with plum beret and books; brown-skinned silver-haired astronomer with midnight cloak and brass instrument; dark-haired alchemist with two buns, apron and blue flask. Row 3: red-haired female ranger with moss hood pushed back and side bow; stocky older balding smith with brown apron and short hammer; dark-braided knight captain with silver armor and cobalt cape, sword sheathed. Match the hunter sheet's warm painted texture, dark fine outlines and stylized character proportions. Preserve each distinct identity. Genuine transparent PNG alpha-zero outside the figures, including between legs and props. No background, no checkerboard, no ground shadow plates, no text, no borders, no added characters, no overhead head-crown view. Deliver the replacement nine-NPC sheet only.

provenance: Buildings/interiors retain text-only generation sources. NPC correction uses the recorded in-project references, then transparent-background extraction and spacing edits. The selected RGBA output is copied byte-for-byte into residents.png; discarded source images are not loaded.
